protocol.scope: General mechanistic and methodological knowledge only
protocol.zero_shot_rule: Exclude the exact source paper and all variant-level measurements for an evaluated assay
protocol.content_policy: Paraphrased guidance; no abstracts or result tables are copied
protocol.selection: Deterministic tag matching; no live retrieval during benchmark calls

items.title: RNAGym: A comprehensive benchmark for RNA foundation models
items.agent_guidance: Interpret the target as the assay-specific measured phenotype and preserve strict separation between model input and held-out fitness labels.
items.limitations: The benchmark description defines evaluation context but does not justify candidate-specific predictions.

items.title: Deep mutational scanning: a new style of protein science
items.agent_guidance: Treat a DMS score as a phenotype produced by the complete selection and measurement pipeline, not as a direct physical-energy measurement.
items.limitations: This overview is protein-focused and supplies only general DMS interpretation principles.

items.title: ViennaRNA Package 2.0
items.agent_guidance: When prediction is available, compare ensembles, base-pair probabilities, accessibility, and uncertainty; do not equate a lower MFE with higher assay fitness.
items.limitations: Thermodynamic secondary-structure models omit or approximate many tertiary, ligand, protein, kinetic, and pseudoknot effects.

items.title: RNA structure probing at single-nucleotide resolution by DMS-MaPseq
items.agent_guidance: If assay-matched probing data exist, use nucleotide accessibility as experimental structural evidence and keep it distinct from in-silico fold predictions.
items.limitations: Reactivity depends on chemical accessibility and experimental context and is not a direct fitness label.

items.title: Four-base DMS probing of RNA structure
items.agent_guidance: Broader nucleotide-resolved probing can complement sequence-based structure hypotheses when an assay-matched dataset is available.
items.limitations: Chemical probing remains condition-dependent and should not be transferred across constructs without alignment and coverage checks.
